data.gender_notes: Brannon is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Brannon is a name of Old English origin. It is derived from Bran, meaning 'raven', and hildr, meaning 'warrior'. The name Brannon suggests a strong and courageous individual, symbolizing protection and strength. The name Brannon carries the meaning “Raven warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Brannon usually hope their child will grow to embody raven warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Brannon has long been associated with strong and courageous individuals in Christian culture. This name can be found in various historical records, particularly in the context of chivalry and knighthood. Brannon bears the legacy of medieval warriors, who, fueled by their faith, battles against physical and moral evils.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, Brannon represents a spiritual warrior, ready to stand firm against the Principalities and Powers. The name symbolizes the unwavering courage and convictions of those who have committed their lives to fighting for truth and righteousness. Moreover, Brannon carries the spiritual imprint of the raven, which, in biblical imagery, signifies protection as the birds are often depicted as protectors of their young (Jeremiah 1:4,5). Thus, a person with the name Brannon is encouraged to develop a spirit of protection and courage in their daily lives, drawing inspiration from both the warrior and the raven.
